title: Cohomological descent for a quasi-coherent module with face maps
statement:
Let $S$ be a scheme [def-pc-scheme] and $Z$ an algebraic space over $S$ [def-trf-algebraic-space]. Let $u:U_\bullet\to Z$ be an augmented simplicial algebraic space such that $U_0\to Z$ and every map from $U_n$ to its matching object are flat, locally finitely presented and surjective; the degree-$n$ matching object is the finite limit of the compatible proper faces over $Z$. Restrict to injective order-preserving maps $[m]\hookrightarrow[n]$ and use the enlarged small etale ringed sites of algebraic-space objects [lem-trf-space-enlarged-etale-ringed-site-model], with fibre-product transition functors and their canonical ring maps. Let $\mathscr M$ and $u$ be the resulting ringed total module category and augmentation [lem-sfb-semisimplicial-ringed-total-category]. A module in $\mathscr M$ is in $\mathcal A$ if all its components are quasi-coherent [def-trf-space-quasi-coherent-module] and all its transitions $h^*F_m\to F_n$ are isomorphisms. For every quasi-coherent $\mathcal O_Z$-module $G$, placed in degree zero, the canonical derived adjunction unit is an isomorphism
$$G\xrightarrow{\sim}Ru_*(u^*G).$$
Here $Ru_*$ is the right derived functor on unbounded module derived categories [def-weil-abstract-derived-category], computed by K-injective resolutions. There is no quasi-compactness or separatedness hypothesis on the spaces.

proof.text: Every augmentation and face map is flat, locally finitely presented and surjective by [lem-sfb-hypercover-augmentation-face-property]; in particular all the module pullbacks used here are exact. This remains true after base change by an etale $V\to Z$. By [lem-sfb-semisimplicial-ringed-total-category], $u^*G$ has components $u_p^*G$ and $u^*$ is exact (exactness is tested on components). Thus the unit in the question is well-defined with this underived pullback. Fix an arbitrary such $V$ and write $V_p=U_p\times_ZV$.

proof.text: Apply [lem-sfb-flat-object-fppf-derived-sections] with $X=V$ and $F=G|_V$. Write $H=F^a$ on the big fppf site of spaces over $V$, and choose its nonnegative injective resolution $H\to J^\bullet$. All $V_p\to V$ and all face maps are flat, so that node identifies $J^\bullet(V)$ with $R\Gamma(V_{\mathrm{et}},G|_V)$ and the compatible diagram $J^\bullet(V_p)$ with the diagram $R\Gamma((V_p)_{\mathrm{et}},u_p^*G|_{V_p})$. These are derived identifications with the augmented face maps, not only isomorphisms of the individual cohomology groups.

proof.text:
In this big fppf site the matching maps of $V_\bullet\to V$ are covering morphisms: they are base changes of the given flat locally finitely presented surjections. By [lem-sfb-space-fppf-covering-calculus] these coverings are stable under composition and base change. The site is subcanonical directly from [def-trf-algebraic-space]: a map into an algebraic space is a map of its fppf sheaves on schemes; compatible maps glue uniquely on scheme charts by the target sheaf condition, and their chartwise equalities agree on overlaps by the same uniqueness. Etale scheme charts are fppf covers by the covering-calculus node, so these chartwise gluings give the required map of spaces. Apply [lem-sc-ringed-hypercover-injective-augmentation-ring] to each injective $J^q$, with $W=V$ and $R=\mathcal O$. It gives the exact augmented row
$$0\to J^q(V)\to J^q(V_0)\to J^q(V_1)\to\cdots.$$
The displayed maps are precisely restrictions with alternating faces. Hence they commute with the resolution differential. No degeneracy pullback, affineness, or injectivity of a pulled-back quasi-coherent module is being asserted.

source.place: Tags 01GE, lemma-acyclic-hypercover-sheaves, and 01GW, lemma-injective-trivial-cech, ringed-module formulation

proof.text:
Put $B^{p,q}=J^q(V_p)$, with total differential $d_h+(-1)^pd_v$. The row spectral sequence of [thm-sp-double-complex-spectral-sequences] has horizontal cohomology $J^q(V)$ in degree $p=0$ and zero in every $p>0$, by the preceding exact rows. Its finite filtration therefore shows that the actual restriction augmentation
$$J^\bullet(V)\longrightarrow\operatorname{Tot}(B)$$
is a quasi-isomorphism. In total degree $n$ only $0\le p\le n$ occurs; thus no bounded cohomological dimension or infinite-totalization convergence assertion is needed.

source.place: Tag 0132, lemma-first-quadrant-ss, applied to the row filtration

proof.text: Use [lem-sfb-face-total-derived-sections] for $F=u^*G$. The compatible column replacements supplied in step 2 identify $\operatorname{Tot}(B)$ with $R\Gamma(V_{\mathrm{et}},(Ru_*u^*G)|_V)$, and identify the augmentation of step 4 with $R\Gamma(V,\eta_G)$. That map is an isomorphism for every etale $V\to Z$. Both sides of $\eta_G$ are bounded below, since $G$ and $u^*G$ are modules in degree zero. The same node's detection assertion now proves that $\eta_G$ itself is an isomorphism in the unbounded module derived category. This proves the stated canonical unit, with no quasi-compactness or separatedness restriction.
